observations: This is a complete single-process run with one run_start and one matching run_end, but every reported playability area remains rejected, so no physical gate advances.

The Sense ray moved the logical and Win32 cursor routes, but menu hover changed only while the physical mouse was moving. SetCursorPos plus posted WM_MOUSEMOVE was therefore insufficient for the shipped input path.
Circle did not provide an exit path from native-stereo gameplay. The candidate handled back only while flat-menu UI was active and had no gameplay fallback through LawmanModule.OnInputKey(Escape).
All 376 sampled subtitle states reported Settings.bSubtitles=false. The absent subtitles are explained by the runtime setting in this run; it does not establish a layering or capture defect.

Movement input reached almost full magnitude on both axes, with 726 moving samples, 71 run samples and 36 jump samples. Slow, poor locomotion is not explained by a clipped stick range; native movement semantics and the measured classic-D3D9 frame pacing remain separate open causes.
Physical HMD translation, crouching and stepping still exposed the local avatar because the camera moved in room scale while the visual skeleton remained at the native actor transform.

The right arm visibly deformed. Telemetry observed targets far beyond the approximately 49.843-unit native upper-plus-forearm reach and controller-to-hand residuals up to 175.967 degrees; clipping such residuals to 30 degrees still forced an anatomically wrong wrist pose.
The runtime applied and restored 240 sampled arm transactions without a recorded write or restore failure, so the remaining failure is visual anatomy rather than loss of transaction restoration.
The classic-D3D9 CPU copy measured 6.890 ms median and 9.692 ms p95 at 1920x1080 per eye, while SteamVR recommended 3400x3468. Raising eye resolution remains unsafe on this transport path.
Inner presenter shutdown still reported shutdown_complete=false despite normal outer run_end.
